# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Shared the authoritative eight-scenario validation suite in `tank_harness`, added a runnable `calibration_report` binary that executes those scenarios through the shared harness and writes persisted JSON/text report bundles plus optional comparison artifacts, extended calibration rows with scenario metadata/provenance/artifact lists, and updated docs/tests to exercise the real workflow instead of the old three-scenario in-memory smoke loop.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Refactored the validation-suite logic into shared library code with authoritative scenario metadata so both tests and calibration reporting use the same eight shipped probes.
2. [Completed] Implemented persisted calibration reporting: JSON/text bundle writers, comparison bundle writers, heuristic vs validated provenance fields, artifact links, and the `cargo run -p tank_harness --bin calibration_report` entrypoint.
3. [Completed] Updated calibration/validation tests and docs to cover the shared workflow, persisted artifacts, and full-suite execution.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt`
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --lib`
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test calibration_report --test e2e_validation_suite`
- `cargo run -p tank_harness --bin calibration_report -- --output-dir /tmp/tank_calibration_run.QeIVJw` completed successfully and wrote `calibration_report.json` plus `calibration_summary.txt`; summary was `total=8, pass=6, marginal=2, fail=0`.
- `cargo run -p tank_harness --bin calibration_report -- --output-dir /tmp/tank_calibration_compare --compare-to /tmp/tank_calibration_run.QeIVJw/calibration_report.json` completed successfully and wrote comparison JSON/text artifacts; comparison reported no status changes.

## Outstanding Risks

- The default calibration run still reports `vs01_cycling_timeline` and `vs08_stocking_density_crash` as marginal because current outputs sit close to their envelope boundaries.
- No separate CI job was added in this stage; the new binary is CI-friendly and exercised locally, but pipeline wiring remains a follow-up outside this patch.
